resolution.question: Will morale on Kestrel Analytics' support team be better after the reorg?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history contains credible evidence (e.g., survey results, manager observations, or team communications) that support team morale is better than before the reorg. Resolve NO if evidence indicates morale is the same or worse, or if no credible evidence is available.
